user_problem: Writers have approved brand samples but lack precise tone boundaries for new copy.
unique_output: A tone constraint card with supplied positive/negative anchors, context limits and wording tests; no factual claim validation.
required_input: Approved sample excerpts, explicit voice preferences and prohibited tone patterns.
critical_rule: Distinguish observed sample patterns from owner-approved rules; never infer factual brand promises from tone.
nearest_existing_and_difference: terminology-consistency-editor changes glossary terms; this defines tone constraints without normalizing terms or evaluating claim evidence.
acceptance_scenario: Preference calm and literal, ban hype, sample says Plan the week. Card flags revolutionary as a hype counterexample without claiming a performance benefit.
